title: Fun Advent Calendar!
text: Fun Advent Calendar!. I am new to advent puzzle calendars. I really like how this one is done. Each day there's a little box to open that contains some puzzle pieces. The pieces are for a section of the puzzle. The quality of the pieces is very good. I haven't opened all of the boxes yet, but the ones I have have been great. Little to no puzzle dust. No peeling. Decent thickness. It comes with a poster. You will need a large area that you can devote to this nearly month long advent calendar.

product_metadata.title: KWYZ Advent Calendar 2023 Christmas Jigsaw Puzzles - Festive Fireplace in Warm Christmas Holiday Puzzle, 24 Parts -1008 Pieces Jigsaw Puzzles for Adults and Kids Countdown to Christmas Puzzles Gift
features: 【Advent Calendar Countdown to Christmas Puzzles】 -- This unique christmas advent calendar puzzles contains 24 numbered boxes to open on the day that corresponds to the number. The inside of each box have 42 pieces puzzles, which belong to the part of the whole 1008-piece jigsaw puzzle. The goal is to finish one section of the puzzle every day between December 1 and December 24 and countdown to Christmas day.

【Material and Contents】-- This puzzles for adults of "Festive Fireplace" contains 1008 pieces puzzles with 24 parts and a poster. Made of 1008 pieces high quality recycled cardboard, sturdy and bend-resistant. Special surface film treatment, color remains freshness after long time storage.

【How this Christmas Advent Calendar Works】-- The first section of this 2023 advent calendar is located at the top left corner of the puzzle, and each day you will add new sections and watch your puzzle grow. When you complete the bottom right section on Christmas Eve, you have finished the entire 1008-piece puzzle.

【Size as the Same as the 1000 Piece Puzzle For Adults】-- Knowing which pieces belong to which section makes this adult advent calendar puzzle a bit easier than other 1000 piece puzzles, so it's easier than 1000 Piece Christmas Puzzles. However, the different sections also have varying difficulty, meaning that some days you will finish your section relatively quickly, while some days will prove to be more of a challenge – even for experienced "puzzlers".

【Unique Gift or Decorate Your Home】-- This jigsaw puzzles 1008 pieces of christmas theme with a beautiful box making it a perfect gift for adults teens on Christmas, and the special ideal to countdown to christmas make it more unique present. After you finished the puzzles, you can frame it and hang it on the wall to decorate your home, make your home more beautiful and warm! Play this christmas advent calendar 2023 puzzle with your familys and welcome to christmas!
